content: Vikram Patel confirmed to Rohan Deshmukh that his Life Insurance policy (LI-2026-0456) is active, resolving a system glitch cancellation notice. Vikram also confirmed that the Sum Assured has been increased to ₹15,00,000, an Accidental-Death Rider of ₹5,00,000 has been added, and the residential address has been updated. Rohan acknowledged receipt of the revised policy documents and confirmed everything is correct.
